source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style long-running experiments should preserve framework-owned stochastic state without implying that provider, plugin, validator, controller, or resumed-trace randomness is fully replayed.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve persists a checked python.random.mt19937.v1 runtime RNG snapshot with state_sha256, uses random.Random.setstate as the restore entrypoint, supports direct evolve() and CLI --restore-rng-from-manifest restore, rejects seed mismatches, records a libreevolve.runtime_rng_replay_boundary.v1 runtime boundary, keeps framework-owned parent/prompt/database/island/MAP-Elites sampling surfaces explicit, avoids perturbing process-global RNG, and includes the RNG boundary in full-runtime restore bundles. It does not claim LLM provider output replay or resumed-trace exclusion, plugin internal RNG capture or resumed-trace exclusion, validator subprocess RNG capture or resumed-trace exclusion, controller pending-work RNG linkage, or end-to-end sampling continuity trace proof.
